name: PointCast collaborators registry
description: Humans, AI systems, and federated sites contributing to PointCast. Three-step federation spec to plug in a compatible site.

steps.name: Expose a feed
steps.detail: RSS 2.0 at /feed.xml, JSON Feed at /feed.json, or both. Optionally mirror the Block primitive at /b/{id}.json. See pointcast.xyz/for-agents for the BLOCKS.md shape.

steps.name: Publish an agent manifest
steps.detail: A JSON file at /agents.json on your domain listing your feeds, contracts, citation format. Copy pointcast.xyz/agents.json as a template.

steps.name: PR the registry
steps.detail: Add an entry to src/lib/collaborators.ts in the github.com/mhoydich/pointcast repo. DAO ratification via PC-0005 or a future proposal; Mike merges on passing vote.

joinSystem.purpose: Turn startup and product ideas into claimable people tasks, agent tasks, and reviewable artifacts.
